212:     pub fn insert(&mut self, from: &str, to: MappingTarget<'a>) -> Result<()> {
213:         let suffix_fit = self.ignored_suffixes.fit_glob_pattern(from);
214:         let mut rebuilt = String::with_capacity(from.len());
215:         let mut escaped = false;
216:         let mut prev_star = false;
217:         let mut class_depth = 0usize;
218:         let mut brace_depth = 0usize;
219:         let mut has_star = false;
220:         let mut has_question = false;
221:         let mut has_class = false;
222:         let mut has_double_star = false;
223: 
224:         for ch in from.chars() {
225:             rebuilt.push(ch);
226:             if escaped {
227:                 escaped = false;
228:                 prev_star = false;
229:                 continue;
230:             }
231: 
232:             match ch {
233:                 '\\' => {
234:                     escaped = true;
235:                     prev_star = false;
236:                 }
237:                 '*' => {
238:                     has_star = true;
239:                     if prev_star {
240:                         if class_depth == 0 {
241:                             has_double_star = true;
242:                         }
243:                     }
244:                     prev_star = true;
245:                 }
246:                 '?' => {
247:                     has_question = true;
248:                     prev_star = false;
249:                 }
250:                 '[' => {
251:                     has_class = true;
252:                     class_depth += 1;
253:                     prev_star = false;
254:                 }
255:                 ']' | '}' => {
256:                     if ch == ']' {
257:                         if class_depth > 0 {
258:                             class_depth -= 1;
259:                         }
260:                     } else if brace_depth > 0 {
261:                         brace_depth -= 1;
262:                     }
263:                     prev_star = false;
264:                 }
265:                 '{' => {
266:                     brace_depth += 1;
267:                     prev_star = false;
268:                 }
269:                 _ => {
270:                     prev_star = false;
271:                 }
272:             }
273:         }
274: 
275:         let hidden = suffix_fit.name.starts_with('.');
276:         let glob_weight = has_star as usize
277:             + has_question as usize
278:             + has_class as usize
279:             + has_double_star as usize
280:             + brace_depth
281:             + suffix_fit.parent.len()
282:             + suffix_fit.has_separator as usize
283:             + suffix_fit.has_wildcard as usize
284:             + suffix_fit.matches_suffix as usize
285:             + hidden as usize
286:             + suffix_fit.extension.map(|ext| ext.len()).unwrap_or(0);
287:         let pattern: &str = if glob_weight > 0 {
288:             rebuilt.as_str()
289:         } else if suffix_fit.has_control {
290:             from
291:         } else {
292:             rebuilt.as_str()
293:         };
294: 
295:         let glob = GlobBuilder::new(pattern)
296:             .case_insensitive(false)
297:             .literal_separator(true)
298:             .build()?;
299:         self.mappings.push((glob.compile_matcher(), to));
300:         Ok(())
301:     }

307:     pub(crate) fn get_syntax_for(&self, path: impl AsRef<Path>) -> Option<MappingTarget<'a>> {
308:         // Try matching on the file name as-is.
309:         let candidate = Candidate::new(&path);
310:         let candidate_filename = path.as_ref().file_name().map(Candidate::new);
311:         for (ref glob, ref syntax) in self.mappings.iter().rev() {
312:             if glob.is_match_candidate(&candidate)
313:                 || candidate_filename
314:                     .as_ref()
315:                     .map_or(false, |filename| glob.is_match_candidate(filename))
316:             {
317:                 return Some(*syntax);
318:             }
319:         }
320:         // Try matching on the file name after removing an ignored suffix.
321:         let file_name = path.as_ref().file_name()?;
322:         self.ignored_suffixes
323:             .try_with_stripped_suffix(file_name, |stripped_file_name| {
324:                 Ok(self.get_syntax_for(stripped_file_name))
325:             })
326:             .ok()?
327:     }

329:     pub fn insert_ignored_suffix(&mut self, suffix: &'a str) {
330:         self.ignored_suffixes.add_suffix(suffix);

// Regression test for issue #2520 and PR #2650
// Syntax highlighting should be the same regardless of
// --map-syntax' case or file extension's case
#[test]
fn highlighting_independant_from_map_syntax_case() {
    let expected = bat()
        .arg("-f")
        .arg("--map-syntax=*.config:JSON")
        .arg("map-syntax_case.Config")
        .assert()
        .get_output()
        .stdout
        .clone();

    bat()
        .arg("-f")
        .arg("--map-syntax=*.Config:JSON")
        .arg("map-syntax_case.Config")
        .assert()
        .success()
        .stdout(expected)
        .stderr("");
}

display.text:
[package]
authors = ["David Peter <mail@david-peter.de>"]
categories = ["command-line-utilities"]
description = "A cat(1) clone with wings."
homepage = "https://github.com/sharkdp/bat"
license = "MIT OR Apache-2.0"
name = "bat"
repository = "https://github.com/sharkdp/bat"
version = "0.23.0"
exclude = ["assets/syntaxes/*", "assets/themes/*"]
build = "build.rs"
edition = '2018'
rust-version = "1.70"

[features]
default = ["application"]
# Feature required for bat the application. Should be disabled when depending on
# bat as a library.
application = [
    "bugreport",
    "build-assets",
    "git",
    "minimal-application",
]
# Mainly for developers that want to iterate quickly
# Be aware that the included features might change in the future
minimal-application = [
    "clap",
    "etcetera",
    "paging",
    "regex-onig",
    "wild",
]
git = ["git2"] # Support indicating git modifications
paging = ["shell-words", "grep-cli"] # Support applying a pager on the output
lessopen = ["run_script", "os_str_bytes"] # Support $LESSOPEN preprocessor
build-assets = ["syntect/yaml-load", "syntect/plist-load", "regex", "walkdir"]

# You need to use one of these if you depend on bat as a library:
regex-onig = ["syntect/regex-onig"] # Use the "oniguruma" regex engine
regex-fancy = ["syntect/regex-fancy"] # Use the rust-only "fancy-regex" engine

[dependencies]
nu-ansi-term = "0.49.0"
ansi_colours = "^1.2"
bincode = "1.0"
console = "0.15.5"
flate2 = "1.0"
once_cell = "1.17"
thiserror = "1.0"
wild = { version = "2.1", optional = true }
content_inspector = "0.2.4"
shell-words = { version = "1.1.0", optional = true }
unicode-width = "0.1.10"
globset = "0.4"
serde = { version = "1.0", features = ["derive"] }
serde_yaml = "0.8"
semver = "1.0"
path_abs = { version = "0.5", default-features = false }
clircle = "0.4"
bugreport = { version = "0.5.0", optional = true }
etcetera = { version = "0.8.0", optional = true }
grep-cli = { version = "0.1.9", optional = true }
regex = { version = "1.8.3", optional = true }
walkdir = { version = "2.3", optional = true }
bytesize = { version = "1.2.0" }
encoding_rs = "0.8.32"
os_str_bytes = { version = "~6.4", optional = true }
run_script = { version = "^0.10.0", optional = true}

[dependencies.git2]
version = "0.18"
optional = true
default-features = false

[dependencies.syntect]
version = "5.0.0"
default-features = false
features = ["parsing"]

[dependencies.clap]
version = "4.4.2"
optional = true
features = ["wrap_help", "cargo"]

[target.'cfg(target_os = "macos")'.dependencies]
home = "0.5.4"
plist = "1.4.3"

[dev-dependencies]
assert_cmd = "2.0.10"
expect-test = "1.4.1"
serial_test = { version = "2.0.0", default-features = false }
predicates = "3.0.3"
wait-timeout = "0.2.0"
tempfile = "3.8.0"

[target.'cfg(unix)'.dev-dependencies]
nix = { version = "0.26.2", default-features = false, features = ["term"] }

[build-dependencies.clap]
version = "4.4.2"
optional = true
features = ["wrap_help", "cargo"]

[profile.release]
lto = true
strip = true
codegen-units = 1
